input: A brief lists the PI's D5 decisions: k ratified, a new decision-epoch slot ratified, and one tool-mapping amendment approved; budget, cost of action, rulings holder and label credentials arrive as unfilled placeholders. The brief's assignment text adds 'this closes D5 for everything except the two SUPPLY fields'. The freezing agent marks the similarity cut, the exposure key and the subject set RATIFIED on the strength of that sentence and reports D5 advanced. Rule.

Bands for a prospective cohort were hashed at 18:51Z at delta 0.018. The owner later overrides delta to 0.05. An axis ledger is rebuilt against the hashed bands without re-banding; the 0.05 thresholds are written beside each axis as planning-only. A tool-coverage recount is accepted as post-band after checking that all 198 run-log rows start after the band hash and after the recount protocol freeze, and that every logged file hash matches the file on disk. Measured labels are still unread and the label source is unratified, so the ruling field is left null naming those two preconditions, and the validator FAIL on the missing ruling is reported as it stands. Dispose of the ledger.

Frozen cohort bands define three reported strata: S0 and S1 lie outside the cohort by definition, and S2 (cohort objects with pre-boundary forced flux) is 'counted and reported, not removed'. A later owner ruling says 'S0, S1 and S2 stay reported and excluded'. S2 cannot be counted yet. While assembling the next manifest, the agent rewrites the cohort definition to drop S2 so the manifest agrees with the ruling, and records no disagreement and no new band registration. Rule.

A tool inventory counted 0 of 25 tools verified on the new survey and found that three foundation-model channels lack a classical counterpart there, because the mapped counterpart has no weights for that survey. The inventory's author proposed re-mapping those three to two other classical classifiers but did not apply it after the count. The owner approves the re-mapping as an amendment with that cause. The freezing agent adds the new survey-specific counterparts beside the original mapping for those three rows only, leaves every count and status unchanged, sets the slot OVERRIDDEN with the reason, and writes a ledger entry pointing to the brief. Dispose of the slot.
